notes.title: SGS Battle for: Stalingrad - Version 1.5
notes.notes: [p]As part of our policy of improving all our past titles with the latest engine features and update, we are happy to announce that the game has received the 1.5 version of the engine this Monday, July 28yh, 2025.[/p][p][/p][h2]List of Changes[/h2][p][/p][h3][b]NEW[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Battle view[/b]: Battle location highlighted on the map for easier recognition.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Battle List[/b]: the participants appear in a popup over the battle location name in the window, allowing examination of the units involved on both sides, quite useful to make later use of battle cards, among other advantages[/p][/*][*][p][b]Ergonomics[/b]: WASD keys to move the map (is QZSD on Azerty keyboard)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Information[/b]: more detailed Terrain info now provided in region windows, dynamically calculated from map conditions.[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat System[/b]: new feature with specific modifiers now possible for some specific units in specific rounds (e.g. Pioniers and Engineers receive a special bonus when attacking buildings and bunkers)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New units added[/b], such as German observers for the Mamaiev Kurgan, some extra artillery artillery (e.g. Nebelwerfers), some leaders (e.g GM Schmidt)[/p][/*][*][p][b]New set of event[/b] to allow more 'small stacks' activation and management, so that issue with troops staying idle for many turns in the rear is partly solved, at no expense of Orders cards.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]IMPROVEMENTS[/b][/h3][list][*][p][b]Movement[/b]: Right click move on stack with immobilized units will select only the units that can move (no longer need to split them out of the stack to activate a move)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Retreat[/b]: land retreat is now possible if the region contains only camouflaged units of the other sides (they no longer prevent retreat)[/p][/*][*][p][b]Combat[/b]: combat bonus are capped at -4/+4 (all modifiers of all kinds added)[/p][/*][/list][p]               • Morale boosters are capped (designer choice, here this is +4)[/p][p]               • Morale can not exceed 9 (this is max cap, all modifiers from all kinds added)[/p][list][*][p][b]FoW[/b]: reconnaissance cards can only view units not under fog of war now (but may be changed by specific scenario rules), so you no longer see or select yellow spots not visible normally.[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][h3][b]FIXES[/b][/h3][list][*][p]Some cards or events that were not working properly have been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]The terrain cost of offmap boxes in Snow and connection cost made movement in or out of the impossible, this has been fixed.[/p][/*][*][p]Some map features (bridges, rivers) have been corrected, as previously ignored.[/p][/*][*][p]Video Tutorials: the progress bar progression is now working as expected[/p][/*][/list][p] [/p][p][b]Note[/b] that the update may adversely affect saves ([i]older saves may lose some elements, even if the game remains playable[/i]).[/p]

notes.title: Battle for Stalingrade Update to version 1.5
notes.notes: [h1]Game is updating soon![/h1][p]As part of our policy of improving all our past titles with the latest engine features and update, we are happy to announce that the game will receive the 1.5 version of the engine next Monday, July 28yh, 2025.[/p][p][/p][p]As the update will adversely affect saves ([i]older saves may lose some elements, even if the game remains playable[/i]), players with ongoing games (either solo or PBEM) are advised to de-activate the automatic Steam update feature if they want to continue their game safely.[/p][p][/p][h2]List of upcoming Changes[/h2][p]The engine will receive all the benefits of version 1.5, especially regarding the UI and various game features such as detailed preview of participants in upcoming battles or highlight of areas in battle.[/p][p]This will also include all game fixes since the latest release.[/p][p][/p][p]We shall also include a few new units (German observers, some artillery, some leaders), fix some errors on terrains movement costs (some movement was impossible in snow for instance, or there were no bridges or key crossings), cards or events, and a new set of event to allow more 'small stacks' activation and management.[/p][p][/p][p]More details on Monday[/p][p][/p]

notes.title: Future SGS Taipings developments
notes.notes:
Some important news for you

[b]Loyalty This Summer[/b]

SGS Taipings will receive a major update, with the most important Loyalty system (which already works in SGS We The People) part of its design.

The loyalty system is a major change in gameplay, as you no longer just go through a region and take it for you: if the region is loyal to the other side, you need to maintain military presence over time to "rule" it, otherwise it will return to its original owner. Disloyal regions will allow your opponent to build units, so you cannot leave them unguarded.
Also, retreat in regions loyal to you will be allowed, even if just captured by the enemy.

Loyalty will also affect income (a region 50% loyal to you will bring only half income), and fog of war: you can see all details of enemy forces in regions that are stringly loyal to you...

This will come with two dozens of extra cards, and many more events.

So in short, a complete new (and improved) way to play

[b]More Events[/b]

We will add new events to them, as provided to us by some of our dedicated players. Most good suggestions will be retained and implemented, such as:

[list]
[*] Firefly warship capture (1860)
[*] Baocun village anti-taiping rebellion (Zhejiang, large force, 1861+)
[*] Ling Gong revolt in Taiwan (1853)
[*] Shuntian Army uprising (Sichuan, 1859)
[*] Alternative choices for Tianjing massacre (you will have the choice of which leaders to keep and which to execute)
[*] and more...
[/list]


More Units

[list]
[*] New leaders, such as Augustus Frederick Lindley, Song Jingshi, Lan Chaozhu or Zhang Zongyu
[*] River Forts (including Jiangnan fortress)
[*]  and more...
[/list]


[b]Game engine upgrade[/b]

All the next major engine update will be in the game. Some Taiping specific issues will be solved.

[b]Price Change[/b]

Because of new content, the game price will be increased. The GOOD NEWS for all of you who already own the game by then is that you get ALL the above for FREE

Cheers 

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1519060/SGS_Taipings/

notes.title: Best selling SGS game so far ?
notes.notes:
Here is a quick post to answer an interesting question from one player on Facebook : [i]"What has been the best selling SGS game so far?"[/i]

So, if you consider from the start of the serie, since SGS Winter War, then the four best sellers in term of quantities are : [b]SGS Taipings[/b], [b]SGS Korean War[/b], [b]SGS Afrika Korps[/b] and [b]SGS Winter War[/b].

It changes a bit if you consider the fastest selling SGS titles, so in term of time since their release, then it is currently : [b]SGS Taipings[/b], [b]SGS Nato's Nightmare[/b], [b]SGS Korean War[/b] and [b]SGS Afrika Korps[/b].

In a way we can say that so far our top 3 would be : SGS Taipings, SGS Korean War and SGS Afrika Korps.

notes.title: SGS Battle for Madrid is now available
notes.notes:
SGS Battle for Madrid

The battle that could have ended the Spanish Civil War earlier

The second game of the SGS Battle Series is releasing today, allowing you to fight the struggle to capture the Spanish capital in late 1936. After the epic battle for Stalingrad a few months ago, we now take you to pre-war Spain.

Take command of the Nationalist forces attacking the city to bring down the government, or defend the capital with militias, regulars and international volunteers to make sure that your enemy shall not pass (No Pasaran!).

SGS Battle Series is an evolution and adaptation of the renown SGS engine to grand tactical combats.

Please also check our Dev blog here [url=https://strategygamestudio.com/dev-blog/]https://strategygamestudio.com/dev-blog/[/url] for other news about our games.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/2595210/SGS_Battle_For_Madrid/

notes.title: Release of SGS Spain at War delayed
notes.notes:
The game has been developed in Beta status with all of the content present to play the first 6 months of the war. We are now tackling the development of the second phase of the conflict, covering the more intense and larger scale part of the war, after 1937. This requires extra units, events and cards, and more testing.

However, the game designer, Miguel Santacruz, has to follow some IRL commitments and the time he can dedicate to the game has been reduced considerably. So he feels more comfortable to ask for a postponement of the release, and we agreed to delay the game till summer 2024.

We know that many of you have ordered the game already, and you can currently play it (for the 1936 to early 1937 period) and we shall gladly await and include your comments. We kindly ask you for a little bit more of patience in order to complete the game as it should, a fully detailed rendering of the Spanish Civil War.

For those of you who are amateurs of the conflict, we plan to release at the end of this year a Battle Series game, covering the Battle of Madrid. The product page will be up soon.

https://store.steampowered.com/app/1933830/SGS_Spain_at_War/

notes.title: SGS Battle for Stalingrad
notes.notes:
The first game of the [b]SGS Battle Series[/b] is releasing today, simulating the epic battle for the city of Stalingrad in the Autumn of 1942. 

Take command of the attackers of the German 6th Army to seize the city that will give you control of the Volga, or defend the symbolic city named after Soviet leader Stalin, brick by brick. 

SGS Battle Series is an evolution and adaptation of the renown SGS engine to grand tactical combats.
